verdict.rationale: Elicit documents an official API for programmatic access from your own code (search 138M+ papers, generate research reports, run systematic reviews end to end), and exposes the same functionality through an official MCP server. However, the evidence never mentions official SDK client libraries (for example Python or JS packages), and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed support-site paths, so builders must work against the raw API or MCP rather than an SDK. Missing for 10: official language SDKs/client libraries, a published OpenAPI spec, SDK reference docs, independent corroboration of developer experience.
